findings.description: The invariant plural unit is still attached as an ordinary counted noun. Removing adjective agreement did not fix singular unit grammar.
findings.recommendation: Caption the invariant unit explicitly, e.g. Restant : {value, number} (unité : {unit}) / Utilisation : {value, number} (unité : {unit}). Keep value before unit; do not introduce plural/select arguments or reorder source arguments.

findings.description: The ordinary counted-noun phrase retains invariant plural labels; at 1 both Quedan and créditos/solicitudes/tókenes disagree. The used caption fixes verb agreement but not the counted plural noun.
findings.recommendation: Caption the invariant unit, e.g. Disponible: {value, number} (unidad: {unit}) / Uso: {value, number} (unidad: {unit}). Caption the unknown-unit remaining quantity too (Disponible: {value, number}) rather than Quedan 1. Keep source argument encounter order.
